text:
Mark Ulfan We started the proces abroad to get my husband invitation to enter Israel, and we were told we cannot start the gradual process while living abroad. He got in with invitation but has a B2 tourist visa.

It took us about a month to get the invetation, after we chased them everyday. I was told not to start the process early as the invetation last for 30 days. So we waited for a month and a half before the flight, and called them everyday to see where we are at. It was very stressful as we already booked a flight. 

If you are just starting the process I would recommend to begin it two three months ahead.
